gloss: misfortune; bad luck; calamity; unlucky age

definitions.explanation: Ill fortune or disaster that befalls someone, often thought to have a supernatural or karmic cause.
Specific ages in Japanese superstition considered prone to misfortune (yakudoshi). Traditionally 25, 42, and 61 for men; 19, 33, and 37 for women.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {厄|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧ (ward off misfortune)
- {厄|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{落|お}とす→落とす：01246_otosu⟧ (cleanse misfortune)
- {厄|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (fall on an unlucky age)
- {厄|やく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あ}ける→明ける：21288_akeru⟧ (unlucky period ends)

USAGE:
The concept of ⟦{厄年|やくどし}→厄年：05809_yakudoshi⟧ (unlucky ages) is deeply rooted in Japanese folk belief. The most feared unlucky ages are {大厄|たいやく}: 42 for men and 33 for women, both of which have wordplay associations with death ({四十二|しじゅうに} sounds like ⟦{死|し}に→死ぬ：00669_shinu⟧, and {三十三|さんじゅうさん} like ⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧). Many people visit shrines for {厄払|やくはら}い (misfortune-cleansing rituals) at these ages.
